title: Hammer Price
summary: A bidding slider whose only true effect is to price the painting past a hidden reserve and remove it from public view, while the ledger shows the artist receiving nothing.
mechanism: An <input type=range> bid against a per-visit hidden reserve; crossing it greys the canvas, veils it as 'withdrawn to a private collection,' and settles a live ledger (hammer price, consignor's profit, artist $0) — client-side only, no storage, no network.
references: The Robert & Ethel Scull collection sale, Sotheby Parke-Bernet, New York, 18 October 1973
